{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Compute response rate per site
response_rate = df_dedup.groupby('site')['responded'].mean()

# Print the response rates for each site
print(response_rate)

# Print the number of unique patients after deduplication
print(f'Number of unique patients: {len(df_dedup)}')

# Print the sites present
print(f'Sites: {sorted(df_dedup["site"].unique())}')"}
